texture-maps.title: Right-Click an Image to Generate Texture Maps
texture-maps.text:
Here's a free tool for those 3d artists out there:

With a simple right click and selecting "generate texture maps" it will turn any image into a folder with :

- Normal
- Bump
- Height / Roughness
- Metallic
- Ambient Occlusion
- Albedo

Works for both windows and mac

Download the tool for free here: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/generate-texture-maps/?src=li-post_texture-maps

pdf-to-dxf.title: Right-Click a PDF Convert to DXF
pdf-to-dxf.text:
---

Free workflow for teams handing designs off to fabrication:

Right-click any vector PDF (Rhino Layout or other) and convert it to a DXF - text, layers and line weights intact, at true 1:1 scale.

Your fabricator gets files they can actually work with, not just a deck.

Works on Windows and Mac.

Download it free: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/pdf-to-dxf/?src=li-post_pdf-to-dxf

seamless-tile.title: Right-Click a Photo to Create a Seamless Tile
seamless-tile.text:
---

Free workflow for designers who render with real materials:

Right-click a photo of a wall, floor or fabric and get a tile that repeats without a visible seam - lighting evened out, edges joined, saved right next to the photo.

No Photoshop, no clone stamp.

Works on Windows and Mac.

Download it free: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/seamless-tile/?src=li-post_seamless-tile

frames-to-video.title: Right-Click Your Frames to Create a Video
frames-to-video.text:
---

Free workflow for turning rendered frames into something you can share:

Right-click a folder of frames and get an MP4, a GIF or a transparent WebM - saved right next to the folder.

No After Effects, no command line.

Works on Windows and Mac.

Download it free: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/frames-to-video/?src=li-post_frames-to-video

pdf-tools.title: Right-Click a PDF to Compress, Split or Convert
pdf-tools.text:
---

Free workflow for anyone sending drawing sets around:

Three right-click PDF tools in one download - compress a PDF under a size limit, split it into single pages with the layers intact, or render every page to JPG.

No Acrobat needed.

Works on Windows and Mac.

Download it free: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/pdf-tools/?src=li-post_pdf-tools

image-tools.title: Right-Click Any Image to Convert, Resize or Combine
image-tools.text:
---

Free workflow for everyday image work:

Three right-click image tools in one download - HEIC to JPG at full quality, lighter copies for the web, and any set of images combined into one PDF.

Everything is saved next to the originals.

Works on Windows and Mac.

Download it free: https://formarosacreative.com/guides/image-tools/?src=li-post_image-tools
